<subject>OreMax...The New Mantra to Reduce IT spending</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define OreMax’s approach. Our agile, hybrid on-site and offshore 24/7 delivery model supports a comprehensive range of managed services – from mine planning software support, system upgrades, and modernization to full IT management, including data centre hosting.

We can offer Tasman Ridge access to our certified Microsoft and TechFlow experts, available at A$25/hr to contribute to your initiatives. With close to 450 specialists and cutting-edge development hubs, our MetroTech centres in Brisbane stand out as the flagship facilities of OreMax and a key advantage for you.

https://www.oremaxtech.com/

Our GeoTech Centres (GTCs) in Brisbane have consistently delivered outstanding project results for clients across Australia, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.

Our Innovation Labs (ILs) and GTCs provide the following services to our partners:

   a.. Cloud migration and integration
   b.. Data analytics and AI modelling
   c.. Application re-engineering and optimization
   d.. Custom porting of legacy mining software
   e.. 24/7 Help Desk and technical support services

While all these services are available at any of our Innovation Labs, clients often benefit greatly by leveraging our offshore GeoTech Centre capabilities. Please visit https://www.oremaxtech.com/

This continuous development and delivery framework allows OreMax to rapidly adjust resource levels, run parallel development streams, and effectively create a virtual 24-hour work cycle on your projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can schedule a brief meeting to discuss further. Looking forward to your response.

Regards,

Jennifer Bryant  
martha.soto@tasmanridge.com.au  
Phone: +61 477 931 475  
https://www.oremaxtech.com/
